name: Marigold V2 — depth map from a photo
description:
Upload a photo and Marigold V2 turns it into a depth map: surfaces close to the camera are bright, far-away surfaces are dark. The depth is relative — rescaled for each picture — not a measurement in metres. Handy as a depth guide for other image/video workflows, for compositing, or simply to study the space in a picture.

There is no prompt and no seed: it runs a single deterministic step, so the same photo always gives the same map. 'Detail' sets how many megapixels the photo is processed at. 1 MP is the model's native size and takes only a few seconds; higher values keep finer edges, but the time grows with the pixel count.

This workflow runs without the optional Sage attention speed-up (it produces a black image with it), so ComfyUI restarts without it when this workflow is served.
author: Template - ComfyUI

exposedParameters.label: Detail (megapixels — 1 is the model's native size)
